story.overview:
As a developer building skills that call MCP tools, I want MCP authentication to work correctly via Programmatic Tool Calling (PTC), so that skills can successfully invoke MCP tools regardless of their authentication type.
Root Cause: MCP tools invoked via PTC (allowed_callers) were failing due to improper auth context propagation. The issue manifested in two ways: 1. No-Auth Bug: Tools with headers: {} weren't receiving explicit empty auth context 2. GCP Identity Bug: Tools requiring GCP Identity tokens weren't receiving the token in PTC auth context format

acceptance-criteria.criterion: MCP servers configured with headers: {} (no auth) successfully execute via PTC. Tools like exa_search work when called from within code execution container. Empty auth context is properly passed through allowed_callers.

MCP servers with authType: gcp_identity successfully execute via PTC. GCP Identity token is retrieved and forwarded through allowed_callers. audience-manager and msci-reports tools work from code execution.
Existing Bearer token auth (like Rube) continues to work via PTC. No regression in tools that were already working.
Error messages for auth failures are clear and actionable. Failed auth attempts logged with specific error context. Langfuse traces include auth-related events.

dependencies.dependency: Epic 6 Skills API integration (container with allowed_callers)
google-auth-library for GCP Identity token retrieval

technical-notes.project-structure-notes: Auth context building: src/skills/container-builder.ts MCP config: src/tools/mcp/servers.ts GCP token retrieval: Uses google-auth-library for identity tokens

story.implementation-notes: Story implemented as part of Epic 8 sprint (2026-01-09 to 2026-01-11). No separate story file was created during implementation. Story file created retroactively 2026-01-12 for documentation completeness. All acceptance criteria verified working in production.

test-categories.category: 8 tests (4 happy path, 3 edge cases, 1 error handling)

relevant-sections.section: Primary skill execution via Anthropic container with allowed_callers for MCP tools. Container parameter structure includes skills array and allowed_callers with auth_context.

Story 8.4 specifically addresses MCP auth bugs for PTC integration. Bug 1: No-auth MCP servers need explicit empty auth_context. Bug 2: GCP Identity auth must pass identity token in bearer format through allowed_callers.
code_execution_20250825 tool type with container parameter. allowed_callers enables MCP tools callable from code execution.

patterns-to-follow.pattern: All required betas consolidated in config.anthropic.allBetas: - context-management-2025-06-27 - advanced-tool-use-2025-11-20 - code-execution-2025-08-25 - skills-2025-10-02 - files-api-2025-04-14
Langfuse events for auth operations: - tool.mcp.auth (with authType and toolName metadata) - gcp.auth.failed (with audience and error context) - gcp.auth.fallback (when falling back to gcloud CLI)
Layered error architecture: - InternalError (logged with traceId) - ToolError (returned to Claude) - UserError (shown in Slack - human-friendly)

dev-record.notes: Story was implemented prior to story file creation. All acceptance criteria verified working in production. Langfuse traces confirm auth events are being recorded.
